host: European Innovation Council (EIC), Horizon Europe Framework Programme
summary: The EIC Pathfinder Challenges 2025 program funds early-stage, high-risk/high-gain deep-tech research projects up to Technology Readiness Level 4. It focuses on four strategic challenges including autonomous robot collectives in construction, waste-to-value devices, biotech for climate-resilient crops, and innovations for circular economy. The program supports visionary science aimed at breakthrough technologies with significant market and societal impact, offering grants up to €4 million.
reporting_requirements: Regulatory awareness and ecological soundness for biotech applications
Demonstration of technology proof of principle up to TRL 4
Presentation of project results for potential follow-up funding
